'''B2-44''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed at the [[Thesh Outpost]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], B2-44 suggested to an Imperial hero that the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] could be more easily dealt with, if one were to take out their source of income - a rare variant of [[Lumni-spice|Lumni]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] produced in Hoth's unique climate.<ref name="TOR" />
